skills.name: Augury
skills.description: Interpret omens and divinatory signs to glimpse likely future events.
skills.restriction: Humans and Elves only; additional Career or Daemonology access rules apply
skills.rulesNote: Mutually exclusive with Psychometry. The app blocks that conflict; resolve Career access, the omen tables, and the full procedure from pages 44–46.

skills.name: Psychometry
skills.description: Read lingering impressions from a person, object, or place.
skills.restriction: Humans only; restricted Career and character-creation access applies
skills.rulesNote: Mutually exclusive with Augury. The app blocks that conflict; resolve Career access, exertion, result tables, and the full procedure from pages 47–48.

references.name: Alchemy
references.description: Alchemy is a practice built on specialisations of the existing grouped Trade skill, not a standalone Skill. The source alternates between Trade (Alchemist) and Trade (Alchemy); treat those labels as the same specialisation.

references.name: Combat Familiar Career
references.meta: Winds of Magic, pp. 184–188; advance scheme p. 188
references.description: Restricted Familiar-only path: Newly Crafted, Combat Familiar, Armoured Mite, and Iron Clad Imp. It has no printed social Status and is indexed as a reference until the app supports Familiar Characters.

references.name: Spell Familiar Career
references.meta: Winds of Magic, pp. 184–188; advance scheme p. 188
references.description: Restricted Familiar-only path: Newly Conjured, Spell Familiar, Mystery Imp, and Wizardling. Power Familiars reuse this advance scheme rather than forming a third Career; the path remains a reference until the app supports Familiar Characters.

talents.name: Concoct
talents.description: Use a free Crafting or Brew Potion Endeavour with Trade (Apothecary) or Trade (Alchemist) away from the usual workshop or laboratory.
talents.rulesNote: This same-ID entry supersedes the Core Rulebook Talent while this pack is enabled; resolve the complete revised procedure from the current source.

talents.name: Magical Assistant

talents.rulesNote: Consult the current source for the eligible assistance Tests.

talents.name: Suffuse with (Wind)
